items.html: *In the Zohar, Parashat Kedoshim, folio 83, col. 1, it is said, in the Sitrei Torah: "The first man had nothing of this world; one righteous man made a coupling with his Nukva, and from that coupling was made one body, whose radiance is greater than all those angels sent on high, etc." First I will explain one matter that I heard from my teacher, may his memory be blessed, in brief; and afterward I will expand the explanation more, according to what I heard afterward.
